messages:
Jules: Heads-up thread for Launch week webinar planning — goal: drive trials via a short demo-first format + 48h promo. Need final topic + speakers by Wed.
Maya: Two topic finalists: 'Inference Migration Playbook' vs 'Practical Latency Wins (PLG)'. Which maps better to trial funnel?
Arjun: Migration = higher intent (fewer attendees but higher conversion). Latency = broader reach. Recommend migration for paid acquisition push.
Sofia: +1 migration for SDR pipeline. But include a micro-demo showing latency improvements to hook watchers.
Jules: Good call. Speakers: internal infra demo (Arjun volunteered), customer case (Nivedita from EchoApps), product PM for migration checklist (Sofia?). Any conflicts?
Sofia: I can do the migration checklist + 3-step playbook. Nivedita confirmed Tue morning. Arjun: I can do live demo but request SSHless staging key & short dataset. No GPU access needed.
Jules: Rehearsal windows (pick two): May 20 9:00am PT (NA) and May 22 4:00pm BST (EU). Can speakers make both?
Arjun: I can do 5/20 morning only. Nivedita can do both. Sofia can make 5/22.
Jules: Run-of-show (32m) draft:
```
00:00-00:03 host intro + TL;DR
00:03-00:13 Arjun live demo (latency before/after)
00:13-00:20 Nivedita customer ROI + metrics
00:20-00:27 Sofia migration playbook (3 steps + checklist)
00:27-00:30 live Q&A (moderated)
00:30-00:32 CTA + 48h promo code reveal
```
Sofia: Landing page copy variants: A) 'Migrate inference in 2 weeks' B) 'Cut per-token cost by Xx with these tactics'. We'll A/B test hero and CTA.
Arjun: Demo needs: staging API key (read-only), small test corpus, network perf baseline. If live fails, fallback: recorded run + annotated deck.
Jules: ops-bot — schedule reminders and push RSVP counts to #marketing every 12h starting 7 days out. ops-bot: will do. :robot_face:
ops-bot: Reminder cadence set: 7d / 72h / 24h / 1h. Speaker checklist will be posted 7 days before rehearsal.
Maya: Lead routing: landing should tag utm_campaign=launch_mig_webinar, utm_content=speaker_demo_arjun. Attend+askQuestion => sales-hot; attend only => marketing-nurture.
Sofia: Also capture watch_time and demo_path (live vs recorded) as crm fields. Use those to score follow-up.
Arjun: Audio/video fallback plan: if screen share stalls >60s, stop & play 60s pre-roll clip while we reconnect. Presenter then does live commentary.
Jules: Promo plan: 1) Email blast to engaged list (segment: visited docs/benchmarks last 30d) 2) LinkedIn ad + organic posts 3) Partner co-promos. Schedule assets by May 10.
Maya: Post-event nurture: 0-48h: trial code + migration checklist. 48-7d: case study + offer schedule call. Tag all MQLs in CRM.
Sofia: A/B signup CTA test: (A) 'Get 48h trial' vs (B) 'Get migration checklist + trial'. Track signups -> attended -> trial activation.
Jules: Action items: 1) Maya: landing + ad copy. 2) Arjun: build demo recording fallback + staging key request. 3) Sofia: signup copy variants + checklist PDF. 4) ops-bot: calendar invites & reminders. Lock speakers by EOD Wed.
Maya: I'll draft landing copy and post in #marketing for review by EOD today.
Arjun: I'll request staging creds from infra and upload demo clip by May 8.
Sofia: I'll assemble the checklist PDF and variant CTAs by May 9.
Jules: Perfect. If we lock by Wed we can run the first dry run on 5/20. Thanks team — short and actionable. :raised_hands:
